notes.title: SPEEDRUN CONTEST | Update 1.0.9.1
notes.notes:
In honour of the game's release, we're launching a $1000 contest.

All you have to do is get on the game's leaderboard!


 1st place - $500
 2nd place - $350
 3rd place - $150


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972465/6f92e4f267aab9ee5f8f88add2797e918d9fe9fa.png


Bugs, glitching and using teammates is allowed.
The use of third party speedrun software is prohibited.

Results will be announced on the 13th of August!

-
